retrieved_chunks.text: Induction stove / microwave sessions are typically 10-45 minutes, 1-3.6 kW, occurring at meal times (morning, midday, evening). At 30-minute meter resolution a single session often averages out to well under 1 kW over the interval, making it very hard to isolate from background noise even when confirmed present by survey.

Refrigerator compressors cycle roughly 4 times a day, each 'on' period lasting around 1-3 hours depending on duty cycle. A candidate episode whose average kW closely matches a household's known fridge rating AND whose duration falls in that 1-3 hour range should be treated as a possible fridge cycle, not an EV or induction event.
